_about: Always-on token budgets, enforced by `python3 scripts/plugin_costs.py --check`.
Always-on is what a plugin costs on every session whether or not it is used, so
it is the number worth capping. On-invoke and lazy reference material are not
budgeted: they are paid only when the component fires, and pushing bulk into
references/ is something to encourage rather than penalise.
The default is deliberately tight. A plugin that needs more gets an explicit
override here, which shows up in the diff and has to be argued for in review --
that is the whole mechanism. Raising a number to make CI green is a decision,
not a fix, and it should look like one.
Overrides sit roughly 10% above current cost: enough that reformatting a
description does not fail the build, tight enough that a new paragraph does.
